user_question: Create a raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for State College.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for State College.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve second State College elevation surface
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain the second elevation raster required for the difference calculation.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate elevation surface covering State College. Exclude the known input_1 artifact. Return the highest-ranked GeoTIFF candidate; runtime QC must verify that it is an elevation raster with suitable spatial coverage.

workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation surface to reference grid
workflow_steps.purpose: Make the retrieved elevation raster compatible with input_1 for raster arithmetic.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample elevation_surface_2 to the reference grid characteristics of input_1, using 30 metre target resolution. Preserve the elevation surface for subsequent raster subtraction. Runtime QC must verify the resulting grid alignment and CRS compatibility.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate elevation difference raster
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested raster showing the elevation difference between the two surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate the cell-by-cell elevation difference as input_1 minus aligned_elevation_surface_2. Output a GeoTIFF raster. Runtime QC must confirm compatible CRSs and aligned raster grids before calculation.

requirements.scope: The retrieved elevation_surface_2 candidate must cover State College.

The two input rasters must have compatible coordinate reference systems before raster calculation.
